# Third-party license texts

This directory preserves unmodified upstream copyright, license and NOTICE texts
for the direct framework, type, build and test dependencies referenced by this
source package. `catalog.json` records exact versions, upstream package URLs,
original filenames and SHA256 hashes. Identical texts are stored once and linked
from each applicable package entry.

The Next-generated declaration references in `web/next-env.d.ts` are accompanied
by the Next.js MIT text. Next.js, React, React DOM, Playwright, TypeScript and the
DefinitelyTyped declarations retain their respective grants and notices.
Playwright NOTICE and TypeScript ThirdPartyNotices are retained in full.

The application's personal noncommercial trial terms do not replace these
licenses or restrict rights already granted for third-party material. Including a
license text does not transfer ownership of its upstream software to this project.

This is a **source-only** distribution: no dependency implementation tree,
platform-native module, WASM binary, browser, Node/NocoBase/PostgreSQL image or
container filesystem is included. Installing dependencies obtains separate
upstream distributions, including transitive and platform-specific components,
under their own terms. This directory is not a complete binary/container license
bundle or corresponding-source/relink offer. A future binary/image distributor
must assess the actual bytes they distribute and preserve their required notices.

NocoBase is obtained separately by the optional installation recipe. Its pinned
version agreement, interface identification and service restrictions are linked
from the root `NOTICE.md` and `LICENSE-STATUS.md`; no NocoBase source or image is
redistributed in this repository.
